neighbours.label: the piece right before a split-off 'h' (over|hang, hedge|hog, ip|hoto, compr|é|hension, de|hors)
fire: The climbers rested under a huge overhang of rock.
The old branches overhanging the pond fell in winter.
A hedgehog crossed the garden at dusk.
Shrews, hedgehogs and moles eat slugs.
I lost those pictures when iphoto crashed.
Elle reste en dehors de la ville.
Cela facilite la compréhension du texte.
quiet: The climbers rested under a huge shelf of rock.
The old branches over the pond fell in winter.
A rabbit crossed the garden at dusk.
Shrews, rabbits and moles eat slugs.
I lost those pictures when my iphone crashed.
Elle reste au centre de la ville.
Cela facilite la lecture du texte.

notes: Direct logits promote 'h', ' h', 'hed', 'hog', 'hoe'. The pole fires before the 'h', so it looks like a next-token unit. ' cliff' reached 0.24 in a probe, unexplained.
